instructions: Get the T-number from .TODO/config.json before adding new numbered tasks. Assign a stable T- prefixed task number to every task in todo-next.md, todo-done.md, todo-future.md, and todo-ignore.md, and keep that number unchanged when moving the task between states. Keep todo-next.md as the only active queue. Move completed tasks to todo-done.md, deferred tasks to todo-future.md, and deliberate no-fix decisions to todo-ignore.md. Keep one task per bullet, include a Links section for related references, and store TODO metadata in .TODO/config.json. Write task descriptions as direct present-action statements and avoid retrospective phrasing such as 'now ...'. Do not duplicate tasks that already exist in todo-next.md.
suggestions: Keep TODO-next focused on important developer and end-user work.
Use shared config under data-config/frontend_shared.json and data-config/server.json for the date/alias rule source.
Document relative date calculation rules and deterministic overwriteToday behaviour.
Write task bullets as stable present-action statements, not retrospectives.
Avoid task wording that begins with 'now', 'now also', 'now removed', 'now always', or similar changelog-style phrasing.
